players.product: DCI transport and optical amplifier modules (800G CFP2) and datacom transceivers; silicon-waveguide optical circuit switch (OCS) at sample stage

quarterly_data.quarter: Wuxi Taclink Optoelectronics half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 results (half-year report): revenue RMB 545,069.47 thousand, up 25.78% YoY; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 98,255.62 thousand, up 249.74%, mainly from higher fair-value gains on other non-current financial assets; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 22,201.00 thousand, up 16.17%; operating cash flow RMB -154,817.10 thousand (more cash paid for raw materials). Datacom was close to 30% of revenue and its gross-profit contribution rose quickly YoY. Inventory RMB 707,240.95 thousand at June 30 (+29.66% from year-end); fixed assets RMB 430,538.02 thousand (+41.93%) on CIP transfers and added expansion equipment.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 revenue RMB 545,069.47 thousand (+25.78%); datacom close to 30% of revenue

quarterly_data.quarter: Wuxi Taclink Optoelectronics half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Products and customers (half-year report): 400G short-reach modules are in continuing batch delivery to domestic internet companies and 400G long-reach products deliver steadily to the overseas DCI market; customer introduction of 800G and 1.6T short-reach datacom modules is on plan, with 1.6T customer validation going smoothly. 800G DCI cards passed customer validation and entered small-batch delivery; 1.6T cards are in pre-research. 10G and 25G tunable modules launched with steadily growing orders; iTLA devices, beyond supplying its own coherent modules, began external sales with fast-growing orders; sales of small-form amplifiers grew quickly; its C++/L++ high-power amplifiers were used in China Telecom's hollow-core-fibre long-haul transmission experiment. Orders in its main overseas regions grew quickly.
quarterly_data.figure: 1.6T customer validation progressing; 800G DCI cards in small-batch delivery

quarterly_data.quarter: Wuxi Taclink Optoelectronics half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capacity and supply (half-year report): Thailand plant construction and fit-out are fully complete and equipment is arriving in batches, but some key equipment deliveries slipped because upstream equipment and instrument makers are fully booked, delaying some Thailand lines and capacity release; the company expects the Thailand plant to enter full production in September as new equipment arrives in H2. The Wuxi base runs stably with capacity rising; Wuxi phase II is on plan and expected in full production in 2027. Tight industry supply caused late or temporarily interrupted supply of some key materials in H1, affecting on-time delivery of sales orders; the company raised prepayment ratios and locked core supply resources in advance to support concentrated Q4 volume production. Prepayments RMB 26,644.05 thousand at June 30 (RMB 3,382.97 thousand at the start of the year). Pump lasers and high-end DSP chips are bought mainly from overseas suppliers.
quarterly_data.figure: key equipment and material deliveries delayed; Thailand full production expected in September

quarterly_data.quarter: Wuxi Taclink Optoelectronics half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Projects (half-year report): the Thailand base construction project (budget RMB 130,000.00 thousand) was fully transferred to fixed assets; the IPO-funded base project is at 93.53% of budget, with phase I in production and phase II civil works in acceptance. Raised-fund projects at June 30: the Taclink Overseas R&D and Production Base project had RMB 186,911.66 thousand of RMB 217,149.95 thousand invested (86.07%), its ready-for-use date postponed again on June 15, 2026, now September 2026; the High-Speed Optical Module Product Line Expansion and Upgrade project 52.38% (RMB 314,304.19 thousand of RMB 600,000.00 thousand), December 2027.
quarterly_data.figure: overseas base project ready-for-use September 2026; high-speed module line expansion 52.38% invested

quarterly_data.quarter: Wuxi Taclink Optoelectronics half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D (half-year report): H1 2026 R&D spending RMB 50,775.73 thousand, up 2.63%, 9.32% of revenue (11.42% a year earlier); R&D staff 244. The OCS project has a budget of RMB 80,000.00 thousand (RMB 13,851.94 thousand spent to date); the DCI equipment project (budget RMB 80,000.00 thousand) is in small-batch trial production; 800G and 1.6T silicon-photonics modules are being pushed to mass production; a C+L integrated DOA amplifier ships in volume. The company tracks LPO, NPO and CPO next-generation interconnect routes and is building its own iTLA, WSS and Shuffle OXC devices.
